name: query_chembl
description: Search ChEMBL for drug compounds, protein targets, or bioactivities. Returns compound properties (MW, logP, SMILES, clinical phase) or target-activity data.

parameters.query: string — gene name, drug name, or ChEMBL ID
parameters.query_type: string — 'compound' (search drugs), 'target' (search proteins), 'activity' (get bioactivities for a target gene)
